items.title: fix(tlon): prevent citations from fetching outside the cited post (#1…
items.summary: fix(tlon): prevent citations from fetching outside the cited post (#142041) * fix(tlon): keep cited post lookups inside the channel-post namespace Channel citations arrive inside remote message content, so the cite `nest` and `postId` were attacker-controlled components of an authenticated Urbit scry path. `/channels/v4//posts/post/.json` accepted separators and dot segments, and `urbitFetch` normalized them through `new URL`, so an admitted sender could redirect the cookie-bearing request to an unrelated scry endpoint. Validate both identifiers as single unreserved path segments before composing the path, and confirm the composed path is unchanged by URL normalization so the request cannot leave the cited channel-post resource. * fix(tlon): handle malformed citation fields safely
